articles.title: Coffee Break: Armed Madhouse – Tactical Nuclear Weapons: A Deadly Temptation
articles.summary: Nuclear weapons fundamentally transformed warfare, granting the unprecedented ability to destroy entire cities with a single strike. This development, while introducing existential threats, paradoxically reshaped global strategic dynamics rather than eliminating conflict. It ushered in an era of deterrence, making mutually assured destruction a cornerstone of international security and prompting a re-evaluation of military strategies.

articles.title: Plan for bigger, heavier, stealthy next-generation destroyers gets defence council’s approval
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council has approved Project 18A, an ambitious initiative to develop next-generation destroyers for the Indian Navy. These advanced warships are designed to significantly enhance naval capabilities, surpassing current models in technology and performance. This strategic move underscores India's commitment to modernizing its maritime defence, ensuring a stronger and more capable fleet to secure national interests.

articles.title: DRDO scientist dies by suicide in Bengaluru; family cites work pressure, says he was being treated for depressive episode
articles.summary: A DRDO scientist in Bengaluru died by suicide, with his family attributing the tragic incident to severe work pressure. They stated he was undergoing treatment for a depressive episode. The case underscores the critical importance of mental health and well-being, even within high-pressure environments like the defence sector, prompting awareness and support for personnel.
